title: Trusted-main push fallback for completed Hostinger build-log evidence

phases.objective: Provide one trusted-main marker-only ARM fallback that executes the already merged canonical completed-build log reporter after connector-created issue comments failed to register the R3B bridge run.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository owner, GitHub Actions, and the configured Hostinger read credential
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A squash merge to main changes only the exact R3B marker and uses the fixed trigger token as the first commit-message line.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A secret-free artifact and Incident #4953 result bind exact main, protected Production, completed build UUID, canonical workflow/reporter/test blobs, extracted source SHA and branch hints, and a deterministic pass/fail classification.
steps: Validate the event is an exact main push and current checkout equals remote main.
Validate protected Production still equals f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896.
Validate the push changed only the exact marker and its content matches the reviewed contract.
Validate the canonical workflow, reporter, and test Git blob identities on trusted main.
Validate Incident #4953 remains open and no claim or completed marker exists for the binding.
Record a durable one-time claim after all immutable checks pass.
Run the canonical reporter regression without Hostinger credential access.
Perform one authenticated GET for build 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658 logs.
Scrub the exact configured provider token from all persisted JSON and Markdown evidence files.
Upload the structured artifact before final outcome enforcement.
Validate the evidence contract and publish the bounded result to Incident #4953.
Require expected Production SHA provenance before the workflow succeeds.
assertions: The workflow has contents read and issues write only.
No workflow_dispatch, issue_comment, pull_request, or pull_request_target execution surface exists.
Current main, event SHA, remote main, protected Production, marker content, and canonical blob identities are verified before the claim write.
Only the canonical reporter reads secrets.HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN.
The Hostinger provider method is GET only.
No build creation, deployment, release activation, restart, provider mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref mutation, force update, or external business send occurs.
The exact provider token is removed from persisted evidence before artifact upload.
The result comment contains bounded identifiers and provenance only and declares secrets_included=false.
The binding cannot be reused after claiming or completion.

phases.objective: Merge the inert workflow registration and then merge exactly one marker-only trigger to obtain the completed-build source-provenance artifact.
Fail closed on ref, marker, commit token, blob, Production, issue, or one-time binding drift while preserving evidence on reporter failure.
The workflow is GET-only evidence and performs no Hostinger mutation canary.
The workflow does not deploy, activate, restart, or mutate Production.
